findings.section: Description / What to do / Acceptance Criteria / Details
findings.issue: Task repeatedly states user-spec 'Критерии приёмки' has 16 items ('16 пунктів' at What-to-do step 1, Acceptance Criteria, and Details->Acceptance matrix). The actual user-spec 'Критерии приёмки' section contains 15 checklist items. The QA acceptance matrix is scoped against a miscounted source, risking a phantom 16th row or a confused traceability check.
findings.fix: Change '16 пунктів' to '15 пунктів' wherever it appears for the user-spec criteria count (or recount and cite the exact number). tech-spec count of 7 technical AC is correct.

Both resolve to the same existing files, but the path style is inconsistent across the batch.
findings.fix: Standardize PK link style across batch (pick one form). Cosmetic only — all referenced files exist and resolve.
